lessons_used: Evidence for specific kinds of changes remains thin, as every category currently has only one test.
Predictions were mostly too high, except in round 5 where the effect was underpredicted.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder).
No clear effect was seen for introducing new flows on the home screen (home, new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for redesigns in adoption (adoption, redesign) or path selection (choose_path, redesign).
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.

candidates.title: Existing Account Sync Reminder Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit reminder hint on the sign-in screen urging returning users to use their original authentication method so their pet data is preserved.
candidates.why: Support logs show 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Please sign in with your original account method to keep your saved pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful sign-in hint within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: High support evidence (8 emails) and config-level change targeting sign-in drop-off.

candidates.title: Pet Movement Animation Preview Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated animation preview screen after photo upload so users can preview how their custom pet moves before waiting for final generation.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is low at 60.9% with a long mean duration of 1017s, and 3 support emails reported issues with custom pet appearance.

new_pet_animation_preview.headline: Preview Your Desktop Pet
new_pet_animation_preview.body: Watch how your new companion will walk and play across your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Adds a valid preview screen within onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Targeting largest funnel bottleneck, but requires new screen release and adds flow length.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Direct Instruction Flow
candidates.change: Replace the standard welcome element on home_intro with a interactive visual breakdown showing right-click context commands for hiding and talking to the pet.
candidates.why: Support emails show recurring confusion after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step drops to 64.8%.

home_welcome.text: Controls Guide: Right-click your pet anytime to talk, hide, or access settings.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Progress Bar
candidates.change: Enable visual progress indicator and estimated remaining time on the waiting screen during pet engine startup.
candidates.why: Home step wait time has a high median of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing users to abandon or suspect the app has stalled.

waiting.headline: Summoning Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Your pet is initializing and preparing to land on your screen.

guard.reason: Adds real waiting progress indicator on waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme wait times (2336s mean) with high-confidence feedback UI.

candidates.title: Split View Photo Upload Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the upload_photos screen into a split view layout with photo picker controls on the left and a companion preview frame on the right.
candidates.why: Adoption is a bottleneck with only 60.9% conversion and high completion times, indicating friction in photo setup.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Select photos of your pet so we can accurately generate their desktop avatar.

guard.reason: Redesigns upload_photos layout while performing the same function.

candidates.score_note: Adoption is major bottleneck, but adoption redesigns previously showed no positive effect.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Experience Clarification
candidates.change: Update headline and body copy on the initial story screen to explicitly describe that pets roam live on top of desktop windows.
candidates.why: Choose path median time is short (8s) but mean time is long (514s), and support receives tickets from users confused about desktop overlay behavior.

story.headline: Bring an Interactive Companion to Your Desktop
story.body: Your pet lives directly on your computer screen, walking alongside your daily windows and apps.

guard.reason: Updates story copy without losing pet introduction job.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy fix addressing specific support confusion with minimal effort.

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout Sign In Redesign
candidates.change: Switch the sign_in screen to a spotlight layout that focuses attention on fast social sign-in options.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9%, and support received reports of the sign-in screen failing or stalling.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet Profile
sign_in.body: Connect your account to save your companion's memory and settings across devices.

guard.reason: Redesigns sign_in screen layout within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in step drops 27%, but prior sign-in layout/reorder tests showed minimal impact.

candidates.title: Checklist Adoption Certificate View
candidates.change: Change the layout of adoption_certificate to a checklist format summarizing pet setup details before generation.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion in the funnel (60.9%), requiring clearer confirmation of pet traits before proceeding.

adoption_certificate.headline: Adoption Certificate Summary
adoption_certificate.body: Review companion preferences before official desktop deployment.

guard.reason: Changing certificate to a checklist summary loses the required official stamp and adoption certificate representation.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Reference Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen 'new_quick_reference' right after home_intro containing a simple cheat sheet of mouse shortcuts for interacting with the pet.
candidates.why: Support mail contains multiple tickets from confused users asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

new_quick_reference.headline: Desktop Pet Shortcuts
new_quick_reference.body: Drag to move • Right-click for options • Click to chat. You're all set!

guard.reason: text in 'new_quick_reference.body' has characters outside the allowed set: ['•']

candidates.title: Ready Notification Option During Wait
candidates.change: Enable system desktop notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted as soon as pet generation completes.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, suggesting users minimize the app during generation and get distracted.

waiting.hint: You will receive a notification when your desktop pet is ready to launch.

guard.reason: Enables notification setting on waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Config toggle for desktop notification mitigates multi-minute background waiting drop-off.
